profile.headline: Staff Security Software Engineer at Box
profile.summary:
Growing up in the internet age, computers were always a passion of mine. I began programming as a sophomore in high school, and later enrolled in college as a Music major at Temple College in Temple, Texas. This experience taught me the true value of practice and how to be persistent in the face of failure. However, having always had a strong love for Natural Sciences and Mathematics, I ended up earning degrees in Physics, Mathematics and Astronomy upon transferring to the University of Texas at Austin. 

Using my programming skills, I landed my first professional job as a Software Engineer for IBM's Cloud Security Services upon graduation, where I started out on an Access Control team and later moved to Key Management. Through this, I've acquired — and continue to acquire — invaluable knowledge in regards to Information Security, DevOps, the Agile development methodology, and building cloud native software.

positions.title: Staff Security Software Engineer
positions.description: Designing and building large scale security automation solutions for vulnerability management of virtual machines, containers, and software artifacts.

positions.title: Sr. Security Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on architecture and implementation of a microservice based security automation platform. Design elements include bringing together makefiles, dockerfiles, and jenkinsfiles templets, as well as in-house python libraries to help other Trust Office teams develop, build, and deploy independent security and compliance automation services quickly and effectively through our CI/CD pipeline.

This platform, as an example, can be used as an integration point between services like splunk and github to source control saved searches, or to run compliance reports triggered via a ChatOps workflow using Slack and Workato.

Additionally, use Hashicorp Terraform with AWS to setup and maintain the state of services such as Lambda, DocumentDB and SQS to help facilitate other security and compliance automation workflows.

positions.title: Security Software Engineer III
positions.description: Work in security automation with a strong emphasis on production security of technologies such as Kubernetes, Docker, etc.

positions.title: Cloud Security/Compliance Focal and Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Security Officer for Key Protect, an IBM Cloud Platform security service. I lead the security efforts for IBM Cloud's Key Protect while working directly with IBM's CISO office. Job details include threat modeling, resources and systems auditing, and ensuring standards compliance. I also do a lot of Golang programming for the team and work with docker and the kubernetes container management system.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer for Access Management and then Key Protect, both IBM Cloud Platform security services.

positions.title: Private Guitar Instructor
positions.description: Provided private guitar lessons to Temple community members.
